page.overview:
Who is Cyclopus?

The Cyclopus, also known as Greens, are an alien species found on Planet Zero. They are a model swap of and behave as he does, although it has tentacles and a single eye on its torso as opposed to claws and a head.

Many of them reappear as Battle Nexus competitors.
